note: Authored deterministic equivalence policy (the build-pack file was not present). No prices. A cheaper machine is not automatically equivalent: candidates must pass every hard constraint, then are scored, then priced by the pricing engine.

default_scope.outside_iran_note: Moving workloads outside Iran is only evaluated when the user explicitly enables it per comparison.

hard_constraints.description: Candidate must have at least the source vCPU count.
Candidate must have at least the source RAM.
Fixed SKUs must include at least the source disk; extra-disk prices are not in the seed.
Sold-out / unavailable SKUs are never recommended.
starting_price and calculator_snapshot rows cannot back an exact saving.
Iran-only unless the user enables outside-Iran comparison.
A dedicated/optimized-core source cannot be matched by a shared-CPU candidate.
Candidate must be priceable exactly for the source workload (e.g. traffic above an included quota with unknown overage fails).

scoring.capacity: score = source / candidate (1.0 when identical, lower when the candidate is oversized).

storage_type_map.note: Used only when synthesizing ArvanCloud component configurations for comparison. Recorded as an assumption on the candidate.
